request: Advanced-route deliverable: oversight vs execution — GRACEFUL DEGRADE on Congressional-interest RED. Pull 18mo of Federal Register documents ACROSS all executive-branch agencies (not just DoD) as the oversight-signal proxy. Publish two DSes to Tableau Cloud under Prep Agent. Execution-side joins to DoD Contracts + USASpending SLED Grants happen at dashboard time.

sources.name: Federal Register 18mo All Agencies
sources.description: Federal Register /documents.json filtered to publication_date >= 2025-01-24 through 2026-07-24 (~18mo). No agency filter — pulls the cross-agency population for downstream Tableau slicing. Envelope: {count, results:[{title, type, document_number, html_url, publication_date, agencies:[{name}], ...}]}.

args.name: Oversight Execution Trend
args.features_description: Row-level Federal Register documents from the last 18 months across all agencies, with primary_agency extracted and days_since_published + calendar features. Compute monthly document counts per (agency, type) at Tableau layer, then join to 'DoD Award Detail' + 'USASpending SLED Grants' by month + agency for the execution side. Divergence flag = F1 z-score > 2 AND F2 z-score < 0.
args.stats_description: Per-(agency, type) monthly Federal Register statistics with 30d rolling counts and z-score anomalies. Elevated z-scores mark oversight-signal surges.

outputs.name: Oversight vs Execution Detail
outputs.description:
Row-level Federal Register documents 2025-01-24 through 2026-07-24, one row per document. Fields: title, type (Rule/Notice/Proposed Rule), abstract, document_number, html_url, publication_date, primary_agency (first agency in the agencies list), days_since_published, plus calendar features. Refresh: daily.

Advanced-route notes: this is the OVERSIGHT-PROXY leg of an oversight-vs-execution view, with GRACEFUL DEGRADE on the Congressional-interest RED gap. F4 Congressional oversight pressure (hearings, CRS reports) is NOT available as a structured DS via any approved external host — Congress.gov API lacks per-agency oversight-intensity metrics and CRS reports aren't indexed. Effect: hearing pressure that hasn't yet materialized as a Fed Register action is INVISIBLE here. Use in Tableau by joining to: (a) 'DoD Award Detail' on month + agency for defense execution; (b) 'USASpending SLED Grants' on month + agency for civilian grants execution. Divergence patterns are QUESTION-RAISERS, not answers.

outputs.name: Oversight vs Execution Stats
outputs.description: Per-(agency, type) Federal Register velocity: monthly counts, 30d rolling counts, z-score anomalies (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True). Use to spot oversight-signal surges per agency.
